data.body:
[P2] Preserve acknowledged output in deadline cleanup metadata

If an oversized execution-result checkpoint succeeds but its `onOperationChange` hook exceeds the deadline, `checkpointedExecutionResult` is set while `preparedTerminalEnd` remains undefined. This dispatches `onInvocationEnd` with `SUCCEEDED` but no `executionResult`, so the telemetry exporter omits the output from its terminal record despite successful execution. Retain the handler result separately before awaiting the checkpoint and include it in deadline cleanup only after acknowledgment. Extend the existing held-state-change-hook regression to assert that End receives the original result.
